dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Nonketotic hyperglycemia–associated hemichorea–hemiballismus (diabetic striatopathy from severe uncontrolled diabetes, with contralateral striatal involvement)

Alternative 1: Hemichorea–hemiballismus due to a basal-ganglia lacunar ischemic infarct

Alternative 2: Focal motor seizure with ictal or postictal dyskinesia

Alternative 3: Structural basal-ganglia disorder causing secondary hemichorea, such as an inflammatory or neoplastic lesion
